classification.difficultyReason: Combine three journey durations and regroup the hours into days and hours.

content.prompt: Graham travelled for 3 days 23 hours by boat, then 26 hours by plane and finally 4 days 18 hours by train to be home for his mother’s birthday. How long did his journey take?

answer.worked:
Add the days and hours separately, then convert every 24 hours to one day.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Total days}&=3+4=7\text{ days}\\\text{Total hours}&=23+26+18=67\text{ hours}\\\text{Total hours}&=2\times24+19=2\text{ days }19\text{ hours}\\\text{Journey time}&=7\text{ days}+2\text{ days }19\text{ hours}\\\text{Journey time}&=9\text{ days }19\text{ hours}\end{align*}$$
